Game Overview

At its heart, Star Force is a arcade game about protect your planet from relentless pirate ships in Star Force's fast-paced arcade action. Dodge and destroy your enemies with precision, collecting power-ups to boost your score. With intuitive controls and captivating gameplay, every age can jump in and enjoy this cosmic battle.
